description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Adukkana,  Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420351 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
